digest.component_or_area: outbound sync dispatch and cross-project validation
propositions: Outbound sync currently fails closed when creating issues targeting projects outside a single configured project, requiring multi-project support via per-ticket project resolution
Create mutations must resolve their target project from ticket.bridge_project against a projects_store.Mapping before both Cloud and Data Center transports receive them
The cross-project guard must relax from equality check to set membership check against the mapping's project set while remaining fail-closed on unsynced projects
A ticket resolving to a project absent from the mapping must emit no create mutation to prevent stale or typo bindings from creating against unsynced projects
The reserved _bridge_target_project key must be stamped on the mutation and read by both transports, but dropped by DC before sending to Jira to prevent invalid field errors
